entry_lifecycle.realization_logic: The book gains if the December SOFR implied yield rises because the 9 December meeting is marked for a larger step than the path already in the contract.

entry_rationale: Open a 2 million short in December 2026 SOFR into the 13 November producer-price print.
entry_thesis: October consumer prices rose 0.4 percent and the two-year is already 4.73, so the level of the hike is no longer the open gap. Cash SOFR is still 3.88 while December three-month SOFR is 4.295. Producer prices on 13 November are the inflation check the committee gets before it meets on 9 December. Pay December SOFR in small size so a confirmed cost shock can lift that contract before the meeting, and get out if the 13 November print does not extend the consumer-price move.

events.rationale: Open a 2 million short in December 2026 SOFR into the 13 November producer-price print.

invalidation: The pay is wrong if the 13 November producer-price release does not extend the October consumer-price rise, or if December SOFR fails to hold 4.295.
